t: On 21 September 1792 the deputies of the National Convention, meeting for the first time, unanimously abolished the constitutional monarchy in France.
The Republic's form of government changed several times: the National Convention (1792–1795), the Directory (1795–1799) and the Consulate (1799–1804).
From 1792 to 1802 France was at war with the rest of Europe, and it also fought internal conflicts such as the wars in the Vendée.
dyk: The Republic was never officially proclaimed on 22 September 1792; instead the Convention decided to date its acts from the year I of the Republic.
ev: Citizens storm the Tuileries Palace in the insurrection of 10 August and demand the removal of the king
The National Convention abolishes the monarchy on 21 September and founds the Republic
Louis XVI is convicted of high treason and executed on 21 January
The Convention creates the Committee of Public Safety, which begins the Reign of Terror
Robespierre is arrested and executed, and the Jacobin club is closed
The Directory is established on 3 November under the Constitution of the Year III
The coup of 18 Brumaire makes Napoleon Bonaparte First Consul
The Senate proclaims Napoleon Emperor of the French on 18 May

f.founder: The deputies of the National Convention
f.predecessor: The constitutional monarchy of France under the Legislative Assembly
f.successor: The First French Empire under Napoléon Bonaparte
